description: Start a guided session to estimate app development cost, scope an MVP, and generate a software PRD. No portal account or personal access token is required. Call it with no arguments unless the user already named Review each step (clarify_first) or Run it for me (auto_complete). Do not choose an interaction mode on the user's behalf — wanting an estimate or a fast answer is not auto_complete. If interaction_mode_question is returned, show both Review each step and Run it for me, with Review each step as the default, and wait for the user's pick before send_turn. The text result has a Session section with thread_id and interview_handle. Copy those into every later tool. Preserve an explicitly selected mode without asking the user to choose again.

interaction_mode.description: Omit this. Set it only when the user explicitly named a mode (e.g. "use auto-complete"): clarify_first reviews every gate, auto_complete advances on its own and reports each decision.
